summary: Manual descent integrity fixes are NOT working. Root cause: DescentGame.jsx passes an incomplete input object to gradeLanding() — safeVy, safeVx, safeTilt, and fuelDepletedInFlight are missing from the call site. gradeLanding() destructures those from `input` and uses them to compute failure reasons, scores and the crashed flag. With them undefined, the failure list stays empty (crashed=false), vyScore/tiltScore become NaN, and the wrong CTA (CONTINUE MISSION) is rendered even after a hard crash at ~42 m/s.

ui_bugs.issue: BUG 1/5/6 broken: input object omits safeVy, safeVx, safeTilt, fuelDepletedInFlight. Result: crashed=false always, grade never F, total score = NaN, row-vy/row-tilt limits display 'undefined', failure-reasons block never rendered, result-continue button appears on crashes instead of result-end-mission.
Header always reads 'MISSION COMPLETE · CREW SAFE' even on a crash — this string is not gated by isCrash (MissionResult.jsx line 36 uses same text for both branches).

integration_issues.issue: Because crashed=false, handleContinueFromResult in Mission.jsx does NOT block progression; a hard-landed crew would be able to click CONTINUE MISSION and reach [data-testid=complete-overlay]. Mission-fatal guard is bypassed at the source (grading).

4. When INITIATE DESCENT is available click it (btn-descend)
6. In DescentGame do NOT press throttle — let LM free-fall

7. Expected: title HARD LANDING, grade F, failure-reasons visible with 'VERTICAL SPEED EXCEEDED SAFE LIMIT', result-end-mission present, result-continue absent.
critical_code_review_comments: DescentGame.jsx grades landing via a fragile duplicated logic path: crashConditions is computed locally and passed as `crashed`, but gradeLanding also derives its own `crashed`. This double source of truth invites drift — the actual failure detection lives in gradeLanding which never receives the required limits. Single source of truth needed.

MissionResult.jsx `isCrash ? 'MISSION FAILED · CREW LOST' : 'MISSION COMPLETE · CREW SAFE'` — both sides show the success string in the rendered output; check whether the ternary was collapsed by a copy-paste bug. In our test with grade D (uncrashed by the buggy grader) it printed 'MISSION COMPLETE · CREW SAFE' — expected, but once crashed is fixed this must be re-verified.

Row `row-vx` never renders a score/max chip (BreakRow called without score) — BUG 6 expects each row to explain contribution; row-vx and row-crew have no chip which is technically OK per formula, but the requirement states each row should show the contribution 'where applicable' — acceptable.
DescentGame.jsx is 894 lines — >700 threshold. Consider splitting HUD gauges, scene components, and physics loop into separate modules.

rca of the issue: gradeLanding() in landingPhysics.js destructures safeVy, safeVx, safeTilt from its input (line 118). DescentGame.jsx builds the input at lines 579-589 without those keys, so absVy > undefined is false, no failure reasons are pushed, crashed evaluates to false, and the vy/tilt score formulas divide by undefined producing NaN. This single missing 4-line addition breaks BUGs 1, 4, 5, and 6 simultaneously.
